discover.description: Find videos in a niche: query variants (flat search, plus an under-4-minute search) and hashtag Shorts pages, per language.
discover.evidence: discovery.json lists every video with the searches that found it.

baseline.description: Each channel's normal: median views of its own recent uploads, Shorts and long-form separately.
baseline.evidence: channels.json: median, sample size, window; 'sample too small' under 10 videos.

score.description: Outlier multiplier = views / the channel's median for the same format; buckets = language x format.
score.evidence: scored.json with tier, views per day, age; language mismatches and unscored videos counted as dropped.

shortlist.description: Top outliers (max 3 per channel) and controls (the same channels' ordinary videos, 0.5-1.5x), confirmed with full metadata; sponsored and live videos excluded.
shortlist.evidence: shortlist.json; format confirmed as vertical <= 180 s for Shorts.

evidence.description: Captions (json3, word timings) or a local Whisper transcript of the first 30 s, top comments (outliers), thumbnail, media (<= 480p; long-form first 90 s), and ffmpeg measurements.
evidence.evidence: evidence/<id>/: captions or transcript.json, comments.json, thumbnail.jpg, measures.json, frames/, contact_sheet.jpg.
evidence.sensitive: downloads media - analysis only, kept local, never re-uploaded

analyze.description: Features outliers share and controls don't (>= 20 points, >= 3 outliers, >= 2 channels); back-test learned patterns on newer videos.
analyze.evidence: analysis.json: comparison per feature with a pattern flag; back-test result.

check.description: Re-read view counts from the watch page HTML (independent of yt-dlp) for a sample of outliers.
check.evidence: spot_check.json with the drift per video.
